title: Product catalog prototype scheme - stock adjustment extension

elements.name: Product Catalog
elements.expected_change: Add item-level Adjust Stock UI and derived availability label display without replacing the existing catalog screen.

elements.name: Product Search, Category and Availability Filter
elements.expected_change: Preserve existing search/category/availability filtering while the product rows display derived availability labels.

elements.name: Create Product
elements.expected_change: Preserve existing create behavior including stock_quantity.

elements.name: Edit Product
elements.expected_change: Preserve existing edit behavior including stock_quantity.

elements.name: Adjust Stock
elements.expected_change: Add a compact item-level action for changing stock_quantity from a product row/card without opening the full edit product form.

elements.name: Product Service
elements.expected_change: Persist adjusted stock_quantity and expose data needed for derived availability labels while preserving existing filters.

elements.name: Products API
elements.expected_change: Keep the existing /api/products resource. Reuse the existing update endpoint for stock adjustment unless the plan explicitly justifies a small helper endpoint in the same file.

elements.name: Product

fields.name: availability_label
fields.derivation: Out of Stock when stock_quantity == 0; Low Stock when 1 <= stock_quantity <= 5; In Stock when stock_quantity > 5

elements.expected_change: Preserve stock_quantity and expose or compute availability_label for display.

elements.name: Products JSON
elements.expected_change: Preserve existing mock product records with stock_quantity. The derived availability label may be computed rather than stored.

notes: This scheme describes a second incremental extension of the products-app prototype, not a greenfield product catalog.

The planner should prefer modify operations for existing product files from the previous run baseline. The new action.adjust-stock should normally be screen-internal inside the existing ProductCatalogScreen.
